'''Hawk Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] that was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Led by [[Hawk Leader]], the squadron attempted several bombing runs on [[Camp Conquest|Outpost Victory]].
